title: BTC/ETH/SOL Binance last price without age expiry, connection-aware availability and 10/10 keepalive
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text:
1. Для всех.
2. А как ты считаешь?

scope.goal: Use the last valid Binance trade price for BTC, ETH and SOL without price-age expiry while its connection remains available; detected connection loss blocks new current-price reads until that asset receives a valid trade on the new connection. Implement the separately accepted native10s Ping interval and10s Pong timeout with its local-processing caveat.
inScope: Exactly two existing reference-client implementations: BinanceBtcUsdTradeStreamService.GetBtcUsdPriceAsync for BTC and BinanceCryptoReferenceTradeStreamService.GetPriceAsync for ETH/SOL; their corresponding socket and per-asset publication lifecycle.

Small internal business connection-generation/availability state and focused deterministic test seams within those two stream files; native ClientWebSocket keepalive settings, no new receive architecture.
Adapt existing BinanceCryptoReferenceDiagnosticsTests, add one BinanceReferenceConnectionPolicyTests file, and update only the relevant README explanation. Exactly five planned governed paths.
Local source edits and focused verification after exact contract approval on the existing master branch; deployment remains user-controlled.
outOfScope: Production or application Local database access/mutation, historical data repair, schema/migrations, backups, service start/stop/restart, deployment and new monitoring.

Other price providers including OKX, Binance channels/endpoints/subscriptions, alternate price feeds, HTTP fallback, new packages, sidecars, generalized receive-pump/queue/framework or new public configuration fields.

Changing strategy formulas, thresholds, lookback windows, history sampling/retention, order-book freshness and execution constraints, timed-close age/market-end checks, balances, fills, settlements or accounting.
New order revalidation after an intent is frozen; cancellation, resizing, repricing, retry or rollback of already frozen/submitted Paper/Live orders because Binance disconnects.
Global diagnostics redesign, deletion/renaming of diagnostic helper APIs, unrelated dirty bookkeeping adoption or any product path outside the five enumerated paths.

requirements.text: Apply the user's no-age-expiry request to all three Binance reference assets, using the connection-aware/per-asset restoration policy adopted by «Фиксируем».
acceptanceCriteria: Both public reference getters cease rejecting an otherwise valid current-connection quote solely because FetchedAtUtc or SourceUpdatedAtUtc is old. Deterministic tests include ages exactly5s, greater than5s, and1hour with a usable connection; no substitute trade-silence deadline is introduced.

Before the first valid trade, while connecting, after detected close/abort/error, during reconnect delay, and after service cancellation/stop, the affected getter cannot supply the retained quote for a new current-price-dependent decision. Cancellation still propagates and an asset that has never had a price retains the existing never-seen exception behavior.

Every newly connected socket starts a new availability generation. Opening the socket or receiving Ping/Pong alone does not make an old quote usable. Only a valid parsed and enabled same-asset trade from that current connection makes that asset available; BTC, ETH and SOL are independent. On the shared ETH/SOL socket, a new ETH point cannot unlock an old SOL point or conversely. Invalid/ignored messages and late work from a previous generation cannot restore availability.

Business availability is synchronized with quote publication and connection lifecycle, separate from best-effort diagnostic state. A socket already observed non-Open/aborted cannot remain usable just because an asynchronous catch/finally/logging path has not yet completed. Detected unavailability is reflected before awaiting reconnect delay or error persistence; no claim of instantaneous detection of an otherwise unobserved network outage.

The returned PriceUsd, SourceUpdatedAtUtc, FetchedAtUtc and Source remain exactly those of the accepted trade. Getter reads, keepalive traffic and reconnect do not fabricate a price, refresh timestamps, or substitute another asset/source. Per-trade latest-price publication remains independent of the existing sampled-price interval.

Remove age-based ObserveStale/ObserveRecovery calls from the ETH/SOL production stream path, so elapsed price age alone neither marks the price stale nor produces a stale/recovery event. Preserve existing diagnostic phase/counter collection and helper implementation; no new global diagnostic event scheme. Existing close/error reporting continues to represent connection failures, not quiet trading.

Existing StaleAfterSeconds configuration fields/validation remain compatible but no longer gate these two client getters; relevant startup wording/README must not present that setting as an active getter expiry rule. Existing sampled caches and sampling schedules are not cleared or rewritten as a substitute for connection-generation availability.

requirements.text: Implement the exact connection-control proposal separately accepted by «Согласуем»: native Ping after10seconds of channel inactivity and10seconds waiting for its Pong, including the disclosed possibility of a local delayed read causing reconnect.
acceptanceCriteria: For each new ClientWebSocket in both existing streams, set KeepAliveInterval=TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10) and KeepAliveTimeout=TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10) before ConnectAsync. Use the native .NET Ping/Pong implementation, not a per-asset no-trade timer, polling task or invented Pong parser.

The documented native semantics apply: after channel communication inactivity a Ping is sent; failure to process the matching Pong within the timeout aborts the socket. This is not a promise that only remote/network failures cause loss or that every outage is detected within20seconds. A long local processing delay can prevent Pong processing and trigger an abort even with a responsive peer; this limitation was explicitly presented and accepted.

A resulting abort follows the existing reconnect/error path with REQ-001 availability invalidation. Existing reconnect backoff, endpoints, subscriptions and message processing order remain unchanged. No generalized receive pump, unbounded channel, added package or hidden rearchitecture to change the accepted caveat.

Tests inspect the same socket-options configuration path used before production ConnectAsync and model close/error/abort restoration behavior without connecting to Binance or an application database. Internal test seams must not bypass the actual business availability logic.

requirements.text: Preserve the adopted policy's boundaries: real quote timestamps and already frozen/submitted orders remain unchanged, with focused regression verification and a concise explanation of the new reference-client behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Do not add Binance connection revalidation, cancellation or economic changes to the already frozen/submitted ExecutionIntent/Paper/Live paths. Only new reads through the two existing reference clients acquire the connection-aware availability policy. No order or accounting implementation file changes.

The separate CryptoUpDown5mResultPollingProcessor timed-close checks for quote age, pre-close data and market-end offset remain unchanged. Removing the reference-client expiry does not authorize an arbitrarily old quote as a market closing price. Order-book freshness, Polymarket Maker/FAK/GTD execution and the exact Maker Paper exception remain unchanged.

Existing consumers such as periodic history sampling may now obtain the same last trade point across a quiet connected interval. Their existing cadence and stored original quote timestamps remain unchanged; do not backfill old gaps, retimestamp the quote or change average/min/max formulas.

README states the exact BTC/ETH/SOL scope, no price-age expiry in the two getters, detected-loss/per-asset reconnection gate, native10/10 settings, delayed-local-read caveat, ignored legacy getter-age setting and unchanged separate timed-close/order constraints. Do not claim the implementation has been deployed or production behavior verified.
